classification.difficultyReason: 1E Q16: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. Division by −4 reverses both inclusive signs; both endpoints remain included.

content.prompt: Solve the inequality and represent the solution on a number line. $$-3\le5-4x\le11.$$

answer.worked:
Subtract $5$, then divide by $-4$, reversing both signs.

$$\begin{align*}-8&\le-4x\le6\\2&\ge x\ge-\frac32\\-\frac32&\le x\le2\end{align*}$$
